title: Store Operations Schedule: Withdrawal Charges and Restocking Destinations across Northbeam Returns and Restocking
content:
Where a returned item goes back onto the shelf, at what discount it goes back, whether the customer may call the return off before the item is received, and what a reshipment then costs, are published for each Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule.

| Return schedule | Withdrawal allowed before receipt | Reshipment fee after a withdrawal in transit | Where the item is restocked | Open box resale discount |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | allowed | 19.99 USD | the store that sold it | 10 per cent |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | allowed | 0.00 USD | the store that sold it | 10 per cent |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | allowed | 49.00 USD | the appliance returns centre | 15 per cent |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | allowed | 0.00 USD | the store that sold it | 15 per cent |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | allowed | 0.00 USD | the outlet centre | 20 per cent |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | allowed | 75.00 USD | the business returns centre | 12 per cent |

**What the columns are.** Withdrawal allowed before receipt is whether the customer may call the return off before the item is received. The reshipment fee is the fee to send an item back out after the customer withdraws a return in transit. The restocking destination is where the item is restocked. The open box resale discount is the discount the item is put back on the shelf at once graded open box, as a percentage.

**Reading the reshipment column.** Three schedules publish 0.00 USD, so a withdrawal in transit on those schedules carries no reshipment charge at all; the three that do publish one run from 19.99 USD on the standard household schedule to 75.00 USD on the business contract schedule.

**Reading the destination column.** Three of the six schedules restock to the store that sold the item; the appliance, outlet and business centres each take one schedule. The resale discount published against a schedule follows its destination, with the outlet centre carrying the deepest at 20 per cent.

**One column that never varies.** Withdrawal before receipt stands as allowed on all six schedules.
